title: Pure Melffy
summary: Melffy cards with generic staples. The Melffy monsters return to the hand whenever the opponent summons, searching or summoning another Beast on the way, and come back at your End Phase, so the deck fights almost entirely on the opponent's turn. The Chaos Origins cards lead: Rabbys searches a Melffy and Fusion Summons when they summon, Footsteps adds four different Melffys, Godmommy stacks on Melffy Mommy and bounces their whole field, and Playtime Surprise Fusion Summons Melffys' Joyful Surprise. Melffy Rabby is the Normal Monster Rabbys wants to search.
